newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-AUSTRALIA NAMES DAVIS CUP SEMIFINAL SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-AUSTRALIA NAMES DAVIS CUP SEMIFINAL SQUAD.

text.p: Australia has named a five man Davis Cup squad for its semifinal encounter with the United States in September, adding Jason Stoltenberg to the team which clinically disposed of the Czech Republic in the quarter-finals.
Tennis Australia on Wednesday named three singles players, big serving Mark Philippoussis, Pat Rafter and Stoltenberg, and doubles champions Todd Woodbridge and Mark Woodforde.
Australia has until 10 days before the September 19-21 semifinal on the hardcourt FitzGerald Tennis Centre in Washington to name its four man team.

Australia's non-playing captain John Newcombe said the United States, which has yet to announce a squad but has hardcourt specialists Pete Sampras, Andre Agassi and Michael Chang at its disposal, would be favourites.
"However, we've been building up for this clash for 18 months," Newcombe said in a statement.

"We've won 21 of our last 23 Davis Cup matches. We've got three players in the top 20, the number one doubles pair in the world and the team believe that this year is our year to win it all," Newcombe said.
Australia reached the semifinals with a 5-0 rout of Czech Republic in April, while the Americans overcame Netherlands 4-1.
The winner will meet either Sweden or Italy in the Davis Cup final in late November.
